teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Supported beginner practice sessions on loops and debugging as a peer programming mentor.
Facilitated discussion of common programming errors and helped peers trace short programs step by step.

projects.title: String Utility Library Testing
bullets: Contributed to a team string utility library project using Python and Git, documenting expected behaviour and regression checks.
Isolated a defect using a minimal reproducing example and designed boundary and invalid-input test cases.

projects.title: Maze Traversal
bullets: Implemented graph traversal and a route or ordering routine for an individual maze traversal project using Python and Git.
Represented maze connections using adjacency lists and explained algorithm choices and computational complexity.
